evals: (()=>{const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules'); const card=h.closest('li'); scrollTo(0, card.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY-170); return 1})()

boxes.title: [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules')
boxes.s1: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules').nextElementSibling; const t=p.firstChild; const i=t.textContent.indexOf('A bidder'); const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(t,i); r.setEnd(t, t.textContent.indexOf('quantities.')+11); return r})()
boxes.s2: (()=>{const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Bidder visibility rules').nextElementSibling; const t=p.firstChild; const i=t.textContent.indexOf('Rates, amounts'); const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(t,i); r.setEnd(t, t.textContent.length); return r})()
